If you're excited to build an innovative space solution, drop a message and let's team up!

Join Team AstroForge!
summary:
LEFT BEHIND, NOT FORGOTTEN is an interactive, student-friendly space exploration project developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It explores the machines, spacecraft, and scientific equipment that helped humans explore the Moon and Mars but were left behind on their surfaces. Through our website, BEYOND ATLAS, users can discover the history and purpose of these space technologies through interactive 3D views, visual storytelling, and step-by-step explanations. The platform features 3D Moon and Mars models, a hardware exploration section, mission information, educational videos, and interactive quizzes to make space science easier and more engaging for students.
Our goal is to preserve the stories of these forgotten machines, inspire curiosity about space exploration, and help the next generation understand the technology behind humanity's journey beyond Earth.

Developed by: Team Astroforge
details:
LEFT BEHIND, NOT FORGOTTEN

LEFT BEHIND, NOT FORGOTTEN is an educational and interactive space exploration project developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 by Team Astroforge. The project focuses on the remarkable machines, spacecraft, and scientific equipment that helped humanity explore the Moon and Mars but remained behind after completing their missions.

Our goal is to make space history more accessible, engaging, and understandable, especially for students and young learners. To achieve this, we developed an interactive web platform called BEYOND ATLAS, where users can explore the history and technology of space exploration through an engaging digital experience.

The platform features interactive 3D models of the Moon and Mars, allowing users to explore these celestial bodies visually. It also includes a dedicated hardware exploration section where users can discover different Moon and Mars exploration machines through 3D views and step-by-step explanations. Educational videos, mission information, and interactive quizzes make learning more interesting and enjoyable.

By combining interactive technology, visual storytelling, and educational content, our project connects students with the real achievements of space exploration. It highlights that space missions are not only about the spacecraft that return to Earth, but also about the machines that continue to tell the stories of human exploration on other worlds.

Our mission is to keep these forgotten machines remembered and inspire the next generation of space explorers.

GitHub Repository: https://github.com/ronid4136/beyond_atlas
